summary: Iteration 15 (Smart Kitchen AI non-food pantry + AI OCR + family calendar) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 19/19 passed (2 external-service skips for OpenBeautyFacts toothpaste and the self-isolated expiring-recipe test). Frontend flows all working: 7 Dispensa chips (pantry/fridge/freezer/cleaning/hygiene/disposable/home) all visible; add sheet on disposable shows 'Finisce il (se ha una scadenza stampata)' label + hint + read-expiry button; after adding 'Tovaglioli' with no expiry the row shows '~21g' badge + 'finisce circa il 07/11/2026' + Finito button; tapping Finito dims row (qty 0) and adds to Spesa; Shopping auto-aisle forcing works (verified in both backend tests and UI with pre-existing 'detersivo' row under Pulizia casa); Scan /scan-barcode page loads, barcode 3017620422003 (Nutella) returns product-card with 🥫 Alimentare tag + read-expiry button; Family page shows member-* chips + 'Tocca un membro per vedere i suoi pasti della settimana' hint; Calendar shows calendar-members with cal-member-all + 2 member chips (user_b51455c02de2 chef + user_42cec3f443bc nonna), selecting Chef shows banner 'I pasti di Chef Test (tu): i suoi piatti personali più quelli di famiglia.'; AI read-expiry OCR returned exactly '2027-05-12' with confidence 1.0 for the PIL-generated 'Da consumarsi entro 12/05/2027' image. No React Native 'text node' console warnings observed on any screen. Deprecated packages: none detected in this iteration. Only cosmetic shadow*/pointerEvents web deprecation warnings (ignored per request).

ui_bugs.issue: `nonfood-info` testID (`<View testID='nonfood-info'>` at dispensa.tsx:157) was NOT visible on the Disposable tab in the empty-list state before adding an item. It only appears when the list has items (or inside the list wrapper). Spec says it should always be shown on non-food tabs. Minor; add sheet correctly displays all non-food hints.

action_items: (Optional, LOW) Frontend dispensa.tsx: ensure the nonfood-info banner renders at the top of the content even when the non-food section is empty (currently only visible once items exist in that section).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _estimate_duration blends single-sample learned averages with the section default (good noise reduction) but after the first 'finito' event the source already flips to 'learned' - spec/test expects this and it works. OK.

server.py pantry_finished: `lasted = max(1, (today - bought).days)` — if the user marks 'finito' on the same day it was purchased (e.g. a test), lasted_days is forced to 1. Fine for UX but worth noting the learned stat may lean low for short tests.

shopping create (server.py:819): aisle forcing only triggers when guess_aisle(name) is in {'Pulizia casa','Igiene e bagno','Usa e getta'} OR the user's chosen aisle is empty/Altro. This matches the test expectations and prevents mis-shelving (e.g. detersivo manually set to Frutta e verdura still ends up under Pulizia casa).
ExpiryReader.tsx uses ImagePicker + api('/api/ai/read-expiry'); on web it opens the file picker which is tested only for button presence - fine per task notes.

scan-barcode.tsx has location chips including Pulizia/Bagno/Usa e getta/Casa (verified by code grep); chips only appear after a successful product lookup (not before) - acceptable UX but could show chips earlier.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all core flows validated; one minor nonfood-info banner visibility)

seed_data_creation: Created & cleaned 4 TEST_* pantry rows (disposable/cleaning/hygiene/fridge) and 4 TEST_* shopping rows (cleaning/hygiene/disposable/food) via class teardown. Left two UI-created items in chef's account from the manual flow: TEST_UI_Tov_37222 (dispensa + shopping as 'Altro'), not cleaned automatically. Learned product_durations entry inserted for test tovaglioli (safe to leave; improves default→learned transition).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter15 verified: 1) POST /api/pantry non_food defaults — disposable 21d, cleaning 45d, hygiene 30d, home 60d; food+fridge no-expiry stays null + is_estimate False. 2) GET /api/pantry/duration-estimate switches from source='default' to 'learned' after a /finished event; /finished reorders to Spesa with aisle 'Usa e getta' (and no duplicate on second finish while listed); 404 for unknown id. 3) POST /api/shopping aisle forcing works for detersivo→Pulizia casa, dentifricio→Igiene e bagno, carta igienica→Usa e getta; food name 'Mele' remains Frutta e verdura. 4) GET /api/products/barcode/3017620422003 (Nutella) → kind food, location pantry, source food. Open Beauty Facts for toothpaste 3600523391998 & 8700216255592 returned found:false (external, skipped — acceptable). 5) POST /api/shopping/to-pantry with location 'cleaning' and no expires_at → kind non_food + is_estimate True. 6) POST /api/ai/read-expiry with PIL-rendered PNG 'Da consumarsi entro 12/05/2027' → exact match {'expires_at':'2027-05-12', raw:'12/05/2027', confidence:1.0}. 7) GET /api/household members include diet key (iter14 regression confirmed fixed). 8) POST /api/ai/expiring-recipe skipped intentionally — chef already has food items expiring so the non-food-only 400 branch can't be isolated without wiping their pantry; backend code at server.py:1202 correctly filters `kind != 'non_food'` from the expiring list. Frontend: all testIDs match spec (loc-tab-*, add-pantry-fab, read-expiry, finish-<id>, nonfood-info, shop-name, aisle-*, scan-loc-*, product-card, cal-member-all, cal-member-<user_id>, calendar-members, member-<user_id>, meal-who-*). Chef account has existing shopping leftovers (detersivo/mele/latte) + 1 UI test row (TEST_UI_Tov_37222); main agent may want to clean these if demoing.
